def format_address_block(shipping):
    r = shipping.get('recipient', '')
    s = shipping.get('street', '')
    c = shipping.get('city', '')
    p = shipping.get('postcode', '')
    res = "\n".join([r, s, f"{c} {p}".strip()])
    return res
fix_rationale: Removed the unintended console print to eliminate side effects, preserving the exact formatting behavior and ensuring the function’s only effect is the returned string.
